title: 下部  第646章 私语晚晴此生不负下部  第645章 牺牲命题终极答案
content_zh:
第一节虚空归凡，散尽道心万般锋芒
上古虚空裂隙缓缓闭合，翻腾百万年的混沌气流归于沉寂。
随着最后一道推演图景在识海彻底消融，凌无妄周身萦绕万千载的法则威压尽数褪去。那些纵横遍布皮肉、深及神魂的裂痕不再向外蔓延灼烧，持续许久的寿元燃尽之痛，也在这一刻骤然收敛，只余下深入骨髓的微凉空寂。
他收束所有本源感知，自万古虚无的规则之巅缓步回落。一步踏出，跨越界域隔阂，从埋葬上古道争真相的裂隙深处，落回新生天道普照的三界九天。
高空之上，澄澈苍穹万里无云，新生的动态平衡天道静静悬垂，温润道韵丝丝缕缕洒落人间，抚平三界残留的乱世戾气，滋养着历经禁锢与战乱的天地万物。放眼四海八荒，山川复苏、灵气奔流、生灵安歇，再也不见旧时代的杀伐硝烟、阶级桎梏与资源掠夺。
这是他倾尽心血、燃尽寿元换来的无恙盛世，是打破三万年畸形秩序、终结上古轮回宿命的全新天地。
可越是目睹这一派清平盛景，凌无妄的道心便越是通透冰冷。
盛世无瑕，苍生无错，秩序无漏。
唯独他这执笔者，是此方完美天地之中，唯一多余的失衡症结。
万千次规则推演的结局仍在识海回荡，那句万古不破的终极真理，深深镌刻在他的神魂深处，再无半分动摇余地。神明有情则偏私，天道无情则恒存。
只要他尚存自我意识，尚存七情六欲、悲悯执念，这方新生天道便永远存在细微破绽，万古轮回的覆灭隐患便无法彻底根除。以身合道、湮灭自我，是唯一解法，亦是最终宿命，无替代、无退路、无例外。
凌无妄抬手，轻轻抚过自己的眉心，那里曾盘踞天道至高权柄，曾承载百万年规则大道，曾俯瞰众生起落、执掌三界兴衰。如今神性大半剥离，权柄已然松动，仅剩一颗历经淬炼、通透圆满的平衡道心，静静存续于凡躯之内。
过往岁月的执念、挣扎、愧疚、偏执，在彻底勘破宿命的瞬间，尽数烟消云散。
他不再纠结于初代天道的残缺疏漏，不再执念于墨规子三万年的畸形偏执，不再悔恨于自己昔日规则的留白漏洞。万事皆有因果，万古皆有轮回，所有的乱世崩塌、秩序异化、生灵疾苦，终究是天道迭代的必经之路。
而他的降临、破局、立道、牺牲，正是这场百万年轮回的最终收官。
风声拂过衣袍，少年身姿清瘦挺拔，褪去了天道执笔者的至高威严，褪去了立道者的杀伐锋芒，此刻的凌无妄，眉眼温润如寻常凡尘修士，只剩一身洗尽铅华的平静与释然。
他心念微动，摒弃脑海中所有关于规则、推演、宿命、大道的思辨，不再思量万古天道，不再牵挂三界秩序。
合道之前，他无需再做苍生的守护者，无需再做天道的校准者。
这最后一段人间时光，他只想卸下所有重担、抛开所有宿命，做一回纯粹的自己。
寻一人，叙半生，了凡尘最后羁绊，赴万古终极归途。

身形一晃，凌无妄踏空而行，没有催动任何法则神通，只是循着最质朴的天地气流，缓缓落向新道盟坐落的南山云台。
云海翻涌，青松挺立，云台之上清风徐徐，没有天界的威严肃穆，没有本源的冰冷孤寂，唯有人间最温柔的烟火气息，萦绕周身。
苏晚晴正静立云台崖边，白衣翩然，素净无华。
她并未修炼悟道，亦未巡查三界秩序，只是静静望着远方连绵山河、错落凡尘聚落，眉眼温柔，神色安宁。自上次共承天罚、道心互通之后，她体内的原初规则便始终躁动不安，与新生天道同源共鸣，冥冥之中，她早已感知到一场盛大且决绝的落幕，正在悄然临近。
她听见身后轻柔的脚步声，无需回头，便已知晓来人是谁。
这世间万千修士、浩瀚众生，唯有凌无妄的气息，干净通透，裹挟着大道温柔，独独能让她心神安稳。
“你回来了。”
清淡温婉的嗓音随风轻扬，没有惊疑，没有急切，唯有一份预知宿命的淡然与沉静。
凌无妄驻足她身后数步之遥，目光落向远方烟火人间，语气平和无波，无悲无喜：“嗯，回来了。裂隙真相，万古悖论，终极答案，尽数勘破。”
第二节坦诚宿命，褪去身份平等论道
山风穿林，簌簌作响，将云台之上的静谧轻轻烘托。
苏晚晴缓缓转身，清丽眉眼间不见半分意外，似是早已等候这一句结局许久。她望着眼前清瘦少年，望着他眼底彻底褪去的迷茫与挣扎，望着那一片极致通透、再无杂念的澄澈眸光，心头微动，轻声问道：“所以，答案是什么？”
凌无妄抬眸，与她清澈的目光静静相对，没有隐瞒，没有遮掩，没有半分神明居高临下的疏离，褪去了执笔者的身份，褪去了引路者的姿态，以最平等、最纯粹的姿态，坦诚自己的终极宿命。
content_en:
The first section returns to the mortal world in the void, dissipating all the sharp edges of the Taoist heart
The cracks in the ancient void slowly closed, and the chaotic airflow that had been churning for millions of years fell silent.
As the last deduction picture completely dissolved in the sea of ​​consciousness, the pressure of the law that had lingered around Ling Wuwang for thousands of years faded away. The cracks that crisscrossed the flesh and penetrated deep into the soul no longer spread outward and burned, and the long-lasting pain of burning out one's life span suddenly subsided at this moment, leaving only a cool emptiness that penetrated deep into the bone marrow.
He restrained all his original perceptions and slowly fell back from the top of the eternal rules of nothingness. One step forward, crossing the boundary barrier, from the depths of the crack where the truth of the ancient Taoist struggle was buried, and falling back to the Nine Heavens of the Three Realms where the new heavenly Tao shines.
High in the sky, the sky is clear and cloudless. The newly born dynamically balanced heaven hangs quietly, and the gentle charm of the Tao is scattered in the world, smoothing the residual violence of the three worlds and nourishing everything in the world that has gone through imprisonment and war. Looking around the world, mountains and rivers are resurrected, spiritual energy is flowing, and creatures are resting. The smoke of killing, class shackles, and resource plundering of the old era are no longer visible.
This is a safe and prosperous age that he has earned with all his efforts and life. It is a new world that breaks the abnormal order of 30,000 years and ends the destiny of ancient reincarnation.
But the more he witnessed the peaceful scene of this sect, the more transparent and cold Ling Wuwang's Taoist heart became.
The prosperous age is flawless, the people are flawless, and the order is flawless.
He alone is the only unnecessary crux of imbalance in this perfect world.
The outcome of thousands of rule deductions is still echoing in the sea of ​​​​consciousness. The ultimate truth that will never be broken is deeply engraved in the depths of his soul, and there is no room for wavering. If the gods are affectionate, they will be selfish, but if heaven is ruthless, it will always exist.
As long as he still retains self-awareness, emotions, and compassion and obsession, there will always be subtle flaws in this new way of heaven, and the hidden danger of destruction in eternal reincarnation cannot be completely eradicated. Combining the body with the Tao and annihilating oneself is the only solution and the ultimate destiny. There is no substitute, no retreat, and no exceptions.
Ling Wuwu raised his hand and gently stroked the center of his eyebrows, where the supreme authority of the Heavenly Dao had once been held. It had carried the rules of the road for millions of years, overlooked the rise and fall of all living beings, and controlled the rise and fall of the three realms. Nowadays, most of the divinity has been stripped away, and the authority has been loosened. Only a tempered, transparent and perfect balanced Taoist heart is left, quietly existing in the mortal body.
The obsession, struggle, guilt, and paranoia of the past years all disappeared at the moment when fate was completely revealed.
He no longer dwells on the imperfections and omissions of the first generation of heaven, no longer obsesses over the 30,000-year-old abnormal paranoia of Mo Guizi, and no longer regrets the gaps in his past rules. Everything has a cause and effect, and there is reincarnation throughout the ages. All the collapse of troubled times, the alienation of order, and the suffering of living beings are ultimately the only way to iterate the way of heaven.
And his arrival, breaking the situation, establishing the path, and sacrifice are the final ending of this million-year cycle.
The sound of the wind blew through his robes, and the young man's figure was thin and tall. The supreme majesty of the author of heaven's way had faded, and the killing edge of the founder of the way had faded. At this moment, Ling Wuwu's brows and eyes were as gentle as those of ordinary mortal monks, leaving only the calmness and relief that had been washed away.
His thoughts moved slightly, and he abandoned all speculations about rules, deductions, fate, and avenues in his mind. He no longer thought about the eternal way of heaven, and no longer cared about the order of the three realms.
Before he merges with the Tao, he no longer needs to be the guardian of the common people, and no longer needs to be the calibrator of the way of heaven.
In this last period of time on earth, he just wanted to unload all burdens, throw away all fate, and be pure himself for once.
Looking for a person, telling the story of half a life, breaking the last fetters of the mortal world, and heading for the ultimate homeward journey of eternity.
With a flicker of his body, Ling Wuwang walked through the air without using any magical powers. He just followed the simplest air flow of heaven and earth and slowly fell to the Nanshan Yuntai where the New Dao Alliance was located.
The sea of ​​clouds is rolling, the green pines are standing tall, and the breeze is blowing above the cloud platform. There is no majesty and solemnity in the heaven, no cold loneliness of the origin, only the gentlest breath of fireworks in the world, lingering around the body.
Su Wanqing is standing quietly in the cloudsOn the edge of the cliff, people dressed in white are elegant and unpretentious.
She did not practice enlightenment, nor did she inspect the order of the three realms. She just quietly looked at the distant mountains and rivers and scattered human settlements, with gentle eyebrows and a peaceful expression. Since the last time she shared the heavenly punishment and the Tao Hearts communicated with each other, the original rules in her body have been restless, resonating with the new heavenly way. In the dark, she has already sensed that a grand and decisive end is quietly approaching.
She heard soft footsteps behind her and knew who it was without turning back.
Among the thousands of monks and countless sentient beings in this world, only Ling Wuwang's breath, clean and transparent, wrapped in the gentleness of the avenue, could only make her feel at ease.
"You're back."
The light and gentle voice swayed gently in the wind. There was no surprise or urgency, only the indifference and calmness of predicting fate.
Ling Wuwu stopped a few steps behind her, his gaze fell on the distant fireworks world, his tone was calm and calm, neither sad nor happy: "Well, I'm back. The truth of the rift, the eternal paradox, the ultimate answer, all revealed."
The second section is honest about fate and abandons the theory of equality of status.
The mountain breeze rustled through the forest, gently accentuating the tranquility above the cloud platform.
Su Wanqing turned around slowly, with no trace of surprise in her Qingli eyes, as if she had been waiting for this ending for a long time. She looked at the thin young man in front of her, at the confusion and struggle that had completely faded from his eyes, at the extremely clear eyes with no distracting thoughts, her heart moved slightly, and she asked softly: "So, what is the answer?"
Ling Wuwang raised his eyes and met her clear gaze quietly. There was no concealment, no cover-up, and no condescending alienation from the gods. He had lost his identity as a writer and his attitude as a guide. He confessed his ultimate fate with the most equal and pure attitude.
